name: growth.referral.viral.loop
description: Design and optimize a patient-to-patient and provider-to-provider referral program that creates exponential growth. Every satisfied patient becomes a broadcaster.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Identify potential advocates (completed 2+ visits)
steps.query: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as visit_count FROM appointments WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

steps.name: Design referral incentive structure
steps.prompt: Design a referral program for DoctaRx telehealth platform. Create 3 tiers: 1) Patient refers patient, 2) Provider refers provider, 3) Patient refers provider. For each: incentive (must be legal for healthcare), messaging, viral mechanics, expected K-factor. Make it irresistible but HIPAA-compliant.

steps.name: Create referral messaging and landing page copy
steps.prompt: Write referral program copy: 1 email template, 1 SMS message, 1 social media post, and 1 landing page headline+subhead for DoctaRx referral program. Tone: warm, trustworthy, exciting. CTA: clear and urgent.

steps.name: Submit referral program for Operator approval
